summary.name: NotePlus
summary.one_liner: A native Markdown notes app for macOS, iOS and Windows that stores plain Markdown files in your own cloud folder, with added Kanban boards, AI chat and Hub webhook messages.
use_cases: writing and organizing notes as Markdown files
syncing notes through iCloud Drive, Google Drive or Dropbox
chatting with AI models about a note
receiving script or CI notifications in a notes app
keeping sensitive notes locked with Touch ID or Face ID
summary.what_it_does: NotePlus is a notes editor that formats Markdown as you type, including headings, checklists, tables, code blocks, linked notes and images, without a separate preview pane. Notes are saved as plain Markdown files in any folder that syncs, such as iCloud Drive, Google Drive or Dropbox, and the page says no account is needed. Notes can be locked with a password and unlocked with Touch ID or Face ID, and on the Mac a secret note locks again after a few minutes away. The Plus features add Kanban-style task boards saved alongside notes, a chat interface for OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, DeepSeek, Ollama and others using the user's own API key, and a sidebar assistant that can read and update NotePlus items. The Hub feature accepts text sent to per-hook URLs from scripts or services and shows it with notifications.
notable: Writes plain Markdown files stored in the user's own cloud folder, with formatting shown inline
Built with each platform's native tools, including macOS 26 and iOS 26 glass design
Chat with multiple LLM providers via your own API key, saved as files next to notes
Hub acts like Slack incoming webhooks for sending text into the app
caveats: Hub is part of a NotePlus license, so it is not free on its own
Requires macOS 12 or later, iOS 15 or later, or Windows 10 or later
AI chat requires the user's own API key from a provider
